column8: Method as before: mean(ink/local-median-21 skin), ink = L<0.6*ref. Cross-check vs a fixed skin box: ship 22/107 = 0.206 vs blaster 16/79 = 0.203 (diff +0.003). Within the 0.08 tolerance either way, neither too dark nor too light. Stroke median 2.0 px on both (p90 2.0 ship / 2.25 blaster). The ship matches the blaster's line weight. Detail: the blaster has solid-filled grip/body blocks; the ship is all fine linework with a dense rib grid (C41-020 stencil style), slightly busier but the same weight. Not an ink fail. The earlier automated 0.12 gap came from the box landing on the jacket and is void.
